title: Premarket · Monday 10/5

headline.title: Brazil elected Bolsonaro by about two points and the whole complex gapped. EWZ +12.0%, ITUB +14.3%, BBD +12.4%. And PTC +35.7% — Schneider Electric is buying it at $205 a share, $22B of equity. Two of the biggest gaps on the board this month, both on weekend news, neither in any catalyst calendar.
headline.summary: This is the exact setup the backtest just measured. Across 19 prior events on this week's names, every gap of 5% or more closed below its open — 6 of 6, and 13 of 19 overall. EWZ at +12% and PTC at +35.7% are the two biggest gaps on the page. PTC has a hard ceiling the others do not: the deal is $205 and it is trading 195.50, a 4.63% spread that will not close until Q3 2027. There is no momentum above $205 — only a two-year wait.

overview:
The index is flat and the movers are all single-story. SPY −0.09%, QQQ −0.26%.

Three upgrades did real work: HOG +5.7% (Citi to Buy), DKNG +4.9% — BofA to Buy, calling prediction markets a “win-win” worth $400M in 2027 fees — and EL +3.5% (Barclays to Overweight). WFC +1.9% on Morgan Stanley.

Energy has two events and no direction. Today is the first session after Sunday's OPEC+ production meeting, and the two-day Energy Intelligence Forum starts with the CEOs of Aramco, Eni, BP and TotalEnergies all speaking. USO is −1.3% into it.

Tomorrow is the week's dense day: MRVL and ZS investor days, AMZN Prime Big Deal Days opens, STZ reports. Wednesday brings FOMC minutes and COST September sales.

Also today: ISM Services 9:00. DDS, ET, SUN and TCBI move their primary listings to the Texas Stock Exchange. Ex-dividend this week: GE, CMCSA, T, VZ.

darkpool.note: No fresh board for this session. The standing read is the one that carried through Micron week: MU topped the single-name print board three sessions running into its 9/30 report — $1.0B at the bid, $936.1M at the ask, and $5.1B cumulative (ask) ahead of NVDA $4.8B (mixed) and META $3.7B (ask). That was positioning into a binary event and the event has passed. What is still live for this week: MRVL drew $577.0M (mixed) on the 9/28 board, one of five semis that took size the night before MU printed — and it hosts its investor day tomorrow. Size arriving two sessions before a dated event it was never attributed to is worth more than size arriving after one. The defensive rotation from the 9/29 morning tape also has not been retired: ORCL $91.3M (bid), CAT $50.0M (bid) and AMGN topping the six-session flow-leaders list at $291.0M — utilities, insurance-adjacent and infrastructure catching size ahead of the data. Pair any of it with price before reading a lean into it.
darkpool.right_note: Two reminders stay on the page because they cost real money this month: STX's $848M mid-side print was read here as bearish and the stock ran +6.93% the next session, and META's Outside (3) candle was read over a catalyst that had not been checked for, into +11.34%. A side is a lean, a candle is a bar, and neither outranks a scheduled event.
